test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

The principal said that he would hold a meeting the next day.

options.text: “Tomorrow, I will hold a meeting,” says the principal.
“A meeting will be held by me,” said the principal.
“I will be holding a meeting tomorrow,” the principal said.
“I will hold a meeting tomorrow,” said the principal.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** The principal said that he would hold a meeting the next day.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"that he would hold a meeting" becomes "I will hold a meeting"**
 
 
• Pronoun "he" is changed to "I" to match direct speech.
 
• Verb "would" is changed to "will" to match the future tense in direct speech.
 
 
 
• **"the next day" becomes "tomorrow"**
 
 
• Time expression "the next day" is converted to "tomorrow" for direct speech.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Indirect: "said that"
 
• Converted to: "said", maintaining the reporting structure.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Starts with a capital letter "I" and ends with a period ".".
 
• Reporting clause follows the quoted speech, starting with a lowercase letter after the comma.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"“I will hold a meeting tomorrow,” said the principal."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "Tomorrow, I will hold a meeting," says the principal. 

 
 
• Uses present tense "says" instead of past tense "said".
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "A meeting will be held by me," said the principal. 
 
 
• Changes the active voice to passive voice, which is not a direct speech conversion.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "I will be holding a meeting tomorrow," the principal said. 
 
 
• Uses continuous future tense "will be holding" instead of simple future tense "will hold".
